OpenOraclePriceCoordinator

Obtains a fresh REP-per-ETH price and coordinates withdrawals, delegated liquidation routing, approval reservations, and terminal cleanup. OpenOraclePriceCoordinator source contract

Read surface

priceFeed() returns the price source; sharedPriceFeed is zero for a standalone question. reportDelegate holds the stateless standalone report creation and validation implementation. In shared mode, the feed owns the canonical price and freshness clock, while each candidate uses an isolated report escrow and operations remain local. Pending getters identify only the latest candidate. Shared staged operations execute separately against any valid canonical price; they are not bound to their initiating candidate. Accepted exposure limits, independent report proofs and owner collateral floors are specified in the shared coverage reference. Configuration getters are MAX_PENDING_SETTLEMENT_OPERATIONS, SETTLEMENT_GAS_OVERHEAD, OPEN_INTEREST_DIVIDER, reputationToken, securityPool, openOracle, weth, liquidationApprovalRegistry, vaultOperations (the VaultOperations executor this coordinator deploys in its constructor), gasConsumedOpenOracleReportPrice, gasConsumedSettlement, gasUnitsForOneDispute, initialReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas, targetPriceErrorForDispute, openOracleSecurityMultiplierBps, settlementTime, disputeDelay, protocolFee, feePercentage, multiplier, timeType, trackDisputes, protocolFeeRecipient, escalationHaltMultiplierBps, maxSettlementBaseFeeMultiplierBps, and minLiquidationPriceDistanceBps. Current report and operation getters are pendingReportId, pendingReportSponsor, pendingOperationSlotId, lastSettlementTimestamp, lastPrice, pendingReportMaxSettlementBaseFeeAttoEthPerGas, stagedOperationCounter, and stagedOperations. lastSettlementTimestamp records when the accepted final report reached settlement eligibility (report timestamp plus settlementTime), not when settle was called, and isPriceValid measures freshness from it: it is true while lastPrice > 0, lastSettlementTimestamp is nonzero, and block.timestamp < priceValidUntil(). priceValidUntil() returns the shared feed’s canonical expiry in portfolio mode and the standalone expiry otherwise. Standalone freshness lasts 5 minutes, or 1 hour on chain ID 11155111 (Sepolia). A shared feed adds one settlementTime to that window, permitting early renewal; pending or rejected renewal never extends the accepted expiry. Exact shared timing is in the OpenOracle reference. Use isPriceValid, minimumToken1ReportAttoEth, getRequestPriceCostAttoEth, getQueuedOperationCostAttoEth, getSettlementCallbackGasLimit, getPendingOperationSlot, getActiveStagedOperationCount, getActiveStagedOperationsPage, getPendingCommitmentOperationId, getPendingSettlementWork, getPendingSettlementOperationCount, and getPendingSettlementOperationIds for derived or paged state. The active-operation cursor is an inclusive live operation ID (zero starts at the newest operation), and the third return value is the first unreturned ID or zero at the end. Pin all pages to the same block; a consumed cursor explicitly reverts. Each page visits only its requested entries. The owner commitment lookup includes expired operations until they are consumed and does not scan the queue.

Security assumptions

Report and staged-operation liveness depends on A16 timely inclusion, A17 corrector capability, A18 independent correction incentive, A19 observable correctable price, and A06 lifecycle executors. When lastPrice is zero, the official client currently needs an offchain market quote to propose the first report; quote availability is a client limitation rather than a protocol security assumption. Proposals copied from a nonzero cached price do not use that quote path.

stageVaultOperations(owner, changeCommitment, actionCount, validForSeconds, proposedRepPerEthPrice, requestedInitialAttoWeth, bountyAttoEth) The VaultOperations executor only (Only vault operations executor); wallets enter through its submitVaultOperations function validForSeconds is from 1 second through 5 minutes; escalation is unresolved; a commitment change has no active preceding commitment operation. With a stale standalone price, any pending report belongs to the owner and the bundle fits the remaining weighted callback capacity. A stale shared bundle funds its own independent report; any call opening a report must meet its funding requirements. Targets are distinct, nonzero other vaults with a positive commitment; liquidation bundles require a receiver health factor of at least 10,000 BPS. All liquidation snapshots and pool safety checks must still pass at execution, and a withdrawal whose resulting REP is zero fails with Withdraw amount has no effect. Records OperationType 3 (VaultOperations) with the submitting wallet as owner and report sponsor. A fresh-price bundle executes commitment changes, other-vault liquidations, and withdrawal atomically; a failure reverts the submission and its deposit. With a stale price, deposits complete immediately and dependent actions queue together. Any change to a queued liquidation target's backing units or underwriting commitment fails the whole bundle, rolling back the owner's commitment change and withdrawal. The failed bundle is consumed while its earlier deposit remains. Standalone mode counts each price action against its four-slot callback batch; shared mode executes the stored bundle separately. Both modes retain the four-action limit within one bundle. Deposits use no callback slot. StagedOperationQueued, PriceRequested when opening a report, ExecutedStagedOperation, and CoordinatorStateCheckpoint; the executor emits VaultLiquidationStaged per target and VaultOperationsStaged before this call
requestPrice(proposedRepPerEthPrice, requestedInitialAttoWeth, bountyAttoEth) with report funding Anyone; standalone mode requires no pending report and a stale price, while shared mode permits concurrent candidates and renewal before expiry Standalone mode requires no pending report and a stale cached price; nonzero proposed REP-per-ETH price, a committed bounty of at least getRequestPriceCostAttoEth() covered by msg.value, and funding and approvals for at least the configured priority report plus the larger of the base-fee and open-interest WETH reports, plus matching REP. Zero requested WETH uses the live-exposure minimum; a larger request voluntarily increases the initial report. Shared mode requires a bounty of at least 101 attoETH and isolates sponsor funding in a new report escrow. The caller must accept any positive excess-ETH refund. Opens and atomically funds a fresh WETH/REP report without staging a new operation, retains the whole committed bounty as the settler reward, then refunds any ETH above the bounty through a low-level caller callback. Callback rejection rolls back the report and initial position. Standalone requests emit PriceRequested and CoordinatorStateCheckpoint from the coordinator. Shared requests emit PriceRequested and ReportFundingAssigned from the feed; they emit no coordinator checkpoint.
executeStagedOperation(operationId) Anyone Operation exists (Staged operation unavailable). Expired cleanup needs no valid price; other operations require a fresh price (Valid oracle price required). Liquidation snapshots and downstream safety checks still apply. Lifecycle failures are emitted rather than retried. Consumes expired operations without requiring a valid price; otherwise attempts an active operation using the current fresh canonical price and its stored safety constraints. Shared execution does not depend on the outcome of the candidate funded when staging. Successful execution or terminal failure consumes the operation and settles its delegated-liquidation reservation. ExecutedStagedOperation, either LiquidationApprovalConsumed or LiquidationApprovalReleased for a delegated liquidation, and CoordinatorStateCheckpoint
expireStagedOperation(operationId) Anyone Operation exists (Staged operation unavailable) and block.timestamp is after queuedAt + settlementTime + validForSeconds (Staged operation active). Permissionlessly consumes an expired operation and releases its liquidation reservation without requiring a valid oracle price. ExecutedStagedOperation, LiquidationApprovalReleased for a delegated liquidation, and CoordinatorStateCheckpoint
recoverSettledPendingReport() Anyone A pending report ID exists and its stored OpenOracle storedGame(reportId).settlementTimestamp is nonzero. Recovers the currently named settled report without accepting its price. Standalone recovery fails the attached callback batch and releases its reservations. Shared mode delegates to the feed’s latest candidate; use feed.recoverReport(reportId) for another unprocessed settled candidate. Shared recovery marks only that candidate rejected and delivers its isolated escrow credits to its original sponsor; staged operations are unchanged. PendingReportRecovered from the report source. Standalone cleanup also emits failed ExecutedStagedOperation, applicable LiquidationApprovalReleased, and CoordinatorStateCheckpoint. Shared recovery emits no operation-cleanup events.
openOracleCallback(reportId, amount1, amount2, uint256, address, address); the last three parameters are unnamed and ignored Configured OpenOracle only (Only OpenOracle) Callback report matches the pending report; excessive settlement basefee, a saturated uint24 report counter, an uneconomic final history record at its recorded base fee plus configured priority fee, a stale report, or zero values reject the price after clearing pending report state. For a standalone coordinator, a valid settlement updates the price and auto-executes the bounded pending batch. Shared coordinators reject this entry point; OpenOracle calls the candidate’s escrow, which authenticates its report ID and calls the feed. A terminally rejected settlement consumes the pending batch and releases every liquidation reservation. PriceReported or PriceReportRejected; operation execution events; authoritative CoordinatorStateCheckpoint records
